task.goal: Support building an AST from raw PHP source held in a string, without writing it to a temporary file first.

decisive_evidence.why_decisive: The requested capability already exists as a public static API, so implementing a second string-parsing path would duplicate shipped behavior. The decisive symbol is deliberately outside the approved scope, which is the situation ranked map evidence exists for.

chain_before.root_cause: agent-loop read the derived search index from ProjectLayout::mapSearchIndex() but never wrote it: `map search-index build` fell through to agent-map's own .agent-map/search.sqlite default. With no index at the owned path, workflow approve omitted --map-search-index and Recall compiled no ranked facts. Nothing reported the degradation.

fix_boundary.note: Only the ownership of the derived index path changed, plus a warning when ranked evidence is unavailable. The same retrieval, the same ranking, the same budget.
